text:
maya: I opened a relnotes draft for the routing + batching changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/520. Need quick eyes on snippets, a deprecation callout, and a short known-issues note.

noah: On it. First pass: depgraph paragraph mentions `redis-prefix-cache` which we removed in v0.9. We should add a deprecation banner and link to a migration guide.

rachel: Snippet check: Python snippet uses `model_alias='kestrel'`  should be `kestrel-v2` or users will hit a 404. I can PR that change.

kevin: Also recommend a single-sentence fallback blurb in the routing table: "During autoscale warm-up, requests may route to compatible smaller variants; pin model_variant to avoid this." Keeps CS happy.

maya: Good. Plan: (1) add deprecation note for redis-prefix-cache with a migration link, (2) update py/js snippets to kestrel-v2, (3) add the fallback one-liner under Known issues, (4) run linkcheck.

bot-ci: PR #520 updated by maya  files changed: docs/relnotes/2024-08-routing-batching.md, snippets/python/kestrel_example.md. CI: linkcheck queued.

noah: Linkcheck report: 2 broken anchors, 1 external redirect. I'll open a tiny PR to patch anchors and propose redirects for external links so we don't break existing references.

rachel: PR #521 opened to swap `kestrel` -> `kestrel-v2` in python and js snippets. Includes formatted tests.

kevin: Draft known-issue wording (pasteable):
```
Known issue: autoscale routing fallback
- Symptom: brief routing to fallback variants during cold starts under high concurrency
- Mitigation: pin model_variant or increase warm pool for dedicated routes
- Tracking: INF-3124
```

maya: Adding that verbatim and a KB link to INF-3124. Also adding a deprecation box: "redis-prefix-cache deprecated  use unified-kv-cache; see migration guide."

noah: PR #522 for anchor fixes created. CI flake on one lint check but shouldn't block merge.

bot-ci: PR #522 merged by noah  linkcheck passing on staging.

maya: Final checklist:
- [x] Deprecation note added
- [x] Snippets updated (py/js)
- [x] Known issue added (INF-3124)
- [x] Linkcheck clean
- [ ] JP localization pending (rachel to open i18n stub)

rachel: I'll add /i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md as a stub once anchors are fully stable. If localization misses the cut we can ship EN now and follow with a localized patch.

maya: Thanks team. Ill schedule the docs publish this evening and post the announcement when JP status is final. :rocket:
